meta.title: Switch between Horizontal and Vertical view
gaps: Directly verify that the pricing sheet's rendered layout changes between horizontal and vertical orientations.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Directly verify that the pricing sheet's rendered layout changes between horizontal and vertical orientations.

steps.note: Open the multi-stage event creation screen containing the pricing sheet.
Provide the required event title for a create flow.
Configure an RFQ stage so the pricing template sheet is available.
Apply the first available RFQ template before adding line items.
Add a line item so the pricing sheet renders.
Populate the pricing sheet and ensure its grid is rendered.
Click the view toggle to switch to vertical view.
Verify the toggle now indicates that horizontal view can be selected, confirming the view changed to vertical.
Click the toggle again to return to horizontal view.
Verify the toggle now indicates that vertical view can be selected, confirming the view returned to horizontal.
